premise.claim: A fresh `helm install` with the current chart pulls a tag that was never pushed (v1.1.0-dcb76167b) and every pod stays in ImagePullBackOff.
premise.reportedComponent: charts/fluid/fluid default image tag (values.yaml version anchor + Chart.yaml appVersion)
premise.evidence: base render: all 12 fluid images tagged v1.1.0-dcb76167b, Docker Hub tag API returns 404 for every one; see results/base.json

liveNote: No live layer needed: the failure mode (ImagePullBackOff) is fully decided by rendered image references + registry tag existence, both of which are deterministic. A kind cluster would only re-demonstrate the same 404.
